_what_this_is: THE REUSE CLASSIFICATION OF EVERY STEP OF EVERY REQUIRED GATE. Evidence reuse (scripts/ci/evidence-reuse.sh) skips work on the claim that a step's verdict is a pure function of the git tree. That claim is true for most steps and FALSE for some, so it is recorded here per step and enforced by tools/validate-ci-reuse-policy.py, which FAILS on any step nobody has classified.

_classes.tree-pure: The verdict depends on nothing but the content of the tree, so an earlier successful run of the same gate over an identical tree already answers it. Must carry `if: ... steps.reuse.outputs.hit != 'true'`.
_classes.always: The verdict depends on something the tree does not fix - git history, wall-clock time, a live external service, pull-request context - or the step produces output this run owes. Must not reference the reuse output at all, and must record why.
_classes.reuse-only: Runs only when evidence was reused, to record that fact. Must carry `if: steps.reuse.outputs.hit == 'true'`.

_eligibility: A hit additionally requires: the same workflow file, an IDENTICAL git tree, the matched commit being an ANCESTOR of the commit under validation, and the matched run being younger than EVIDENCE_REUSE_MAX_AGE_HOURS (24). Tree equality alone proves identical content, not identical history, moment or external world.
